title: PCG divers join search for missing farmer in Bukidnon river

blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — A specialized Philippine Coast Guard scuba diving team from Cagayan de Oro City reinforced the search and retrieval operation on Wednesday for a farmer who went missing at a river here. Rocky Bitos, 38, a resident of Barangay Colonia, went missing on Sunday after powerful currents of the Manupai River overwhelmed the handmade bamboo raft (gakit) he and his companions were riding. His 15-year-old son, Mark, and three neighbors—all men in their 40s- managed to swim to safety.
